text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize the prohibition of U-turns on Fairlawn Avenue and on Brookdale Avenue, between Greer Road and Elm Road. These two streets are adjacent to John Wanless Public School. The proposed prohibitions will enhance the safety for pedestrians destined to/from the school and will enhance the flow of traffic on the subject sections of Fairlawn Avenue and Brookdale Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited eastbound and westbound U-turn movements at all times on Fairlawn Avenue, between Greer Road and Elm Road. 2. Prohibited eastbound and westbound U-turn movements at all times on Brookdale Avenue, between Greer Road and Elm Road.
